content.value: A hydrofoil of 0.35 m long and 2 m wide is placed in a uniform seawater flow of 15m/s, with $\rho = 1 0 2 5 \mathrm { k g } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 3 }$ and $v = 1 . 0 5 \times 1 0 ^ { - 6 } ~ \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 } / s$ . Estimate the boundary layer thickness at the end of the plate. Also, estimate the friction drag for (i) turbulent smoothwall flow from the leading edge, (ii) laminar turbulent flow with $R _ { e } = 5 \times 1 0 ^ { 5 }$ , and (iii) turbulent rough wall flow with e = 0.12 mm.
